card.name: Abstract words in scholarly explanations
card.fires_on: Scattered words in explanatory science or academic prose, such as 'because', 'perspective', 'interpretation', 'an' and the ending of 'normative'. They often come just before an abstract noun or explanation.

modes.label: Reasoning connectors
modes.description: Words like 'because' or 'an' that introduce a cause or an underlying explanation.
modes.example: arise simply<< because>> of their different orientations to the observer.

modes.label: Abstract nouns
modes.description: Nouns such as 'perspective' or 'interpretation' in academic or science-news text.
modes.example: put the global temperature trends into a long-range<< perspective>>, Marcott said.

card.plain: It fires on scattered words in academic or science-explaining prose, especially 'because' and abstract nouns like 'perspective'.
